phase: Continuous wrists, cleaned collar and folded slipper bows
note: Reviewed actual front, portrait, grip and slipper renders. The wrist cap crease is removed; the hair ends are pointed and the collar no longer intersects the shoulder patches. Slipper ribbons are real folded meshes. Remaining work: the raised-hand gesture, cloth drape, collar asymmetry, small toe-cap openings, and closer head proportions. The 95/100 target is not yet met.

journal.title: First assembled model: lighting correction needed
journal.notes: The complete original model renders and exports. Visual review found severe highlight clipping, one eye partly obscured by the fringe, and a cylindrical garment silhouette. The next pass corrects shading and opens both eyes before judging finer detail.

journal.title: Colors restored; both eyes readable
journal.notes: Bounded cel illumination restores the lavender hair and original cat print. Both eyes are visible. Close inspection reveals a hair-cap intersection in the forehead opening, an overly rounded collar, stiff shirt shaping, and insufficiently asymmetric back hair. These are the next geometry corrections.

journal.title: Five-view inspection: anatomy and garment fit
journal.notes: The face, proportions, and collar are closer. Side and back checks exposed overly sharp knee bends, thighs intersecting the shorts, visible sleeve-root gaps, and abrupt back-hair roots. The next pass rebuilds rounded knees and fits the shorts to the actual posed thighs.

journal.title: Rounded knees; fitted shorts
journal.notes: The legs retain matched segment lengths, the knee transitions are rounded in profile, and the thighs stay inside the shorts. Remaining priorities are the visible back-hair roots, side-scalp coverage, sleeve joins, and a softer pillow silhouette.

journal.title: R05 reviewed: hair and profile corrections next
journal.notes: Reviewed front, side, back, and face. The model is recognizable, with rounded equal-length legs and original clothing. Side-scalp gaps, abrupt back-hair roots, a squared collar, and stiff raised fingers remain visible.

journal.title: Crown-rooted hair and quieter expression
journal.notes: Reviewed actual front, side, and back renders. Back tresses now flow from the crown and the eyelids better match the quiet reference expression. The side forehead still escapes the scalp shell, and the collar became too scalloped; these need targeted geometry fixes, not a higher claimed score.

journal.title: Reconstructed proportions, hands and soft pajama details
journal.notes: Actual front, face, side and grip renders reviewed. Matched leg lengths and a higher knee line improve the pose; the original print and pocket have been rebuilt. Remaining defects: blunt side-hair endings, collar intersections, a wrist crease and underspecified slipper bows. This is a recovery checkpoint, not the 95/100 target.

journal.title: Continuous wrists, cleaned collar and folded slipper bows

Slipper ribbons are real folded meshes. Remaining work: the raised-hand gesture, cloth drape, collar asymmetry, small toe-cap openings, and closer head proportions. The 95/100 target is not yet met.
